trigger: lru_.emplace_front then index_.emplace is a non-atomic two-step update; if index_.emplace throws (bad_alloc), lru_ holds a front node index_ doesn't know about
summary: Consequence is bounded, not a leak: a later observation of the same rule_id creates a second list node; when the orphan reaches the back, index_.erase(rule_id) removes the LIVE entry's mapping and pop_back() evicts the orphan, leaving the live node as the new orphan - self-correcting, bounded by kCapacity, mutex released via RAII either way. Old code (atomics only) was effectively noexcept; new code trades that for allocation, an inherent accepted cost of the redesign. Not fixed in this run: no production trigger (OOM only), self-correcting, and a try/catch rollback would add code for a hazard with no observed wrong outcome.
adjudication_rationale: Valid, bounded, self-correcting robustness note with no I1/I2/I3 impact and no production trigger; parked rather than fixed to keep the fix round scoped to findings that change observed behavior or correct a false claim.
